title: Ras el Hanout Traybake
rawIngredients: Large handful of flat-leaf parsley, roughly chopped
2 tsp pink peppercorns (optional but very nice)
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
method: Preheat oven to 130°C fan / 150°C / gas 2. Place butter, ras el hanout, lemon zest, and crushed garlic in a roasting tin, then heat in the oven for 5 minutes to melt butter and toast spices.
Trim mushrooms and peel/halve shallots. Add them to the tin with the melted spice butter, season well with sea salt and black pepper, and mix thoroughly. Cover with foil and roast for 1 hour.
Increase oven temperature to 150°C fan / 170°C / gas 3 and remove foil. Squeeze over lemon juice, add diced halloumi, mix well, and scatter pine nuts over the top. Roast uncovered for 15 minutes.
Adjust salt seasoning to taste, then scatter with chopped flat-leaf parsley and pink peppercorns before serving.
